meta.title: TipTap Editor for WordPress
meta.description: Try TipTap Editor — a modern TipTap/ProseMirror-based replacement for TinyMCE.
meta.author: cbspire

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Playground demo helper.
 *
 * TipTap Editor never overrides Gutenberg, so for the demo we opt the
 * 'post' post type out of the block editor. This makes the classic edit
 * screen load, where TipTap replaces TinyMCE.
 */
add_filter(
	'use_block_editor_for_post_type',
	static function ( $use_block_editor, $post_type ) {
		return 'post' === $post_type ? false : $use_block_editor;
	},
	10,
	2
);
